Subject: Sponsor intro & demo — CIO/VP attendance windows

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking a first look at Redwood. We'd love to do a short executive intro followed by a 35–40 minute demo focused on integrations and inference economics. To make sure the right execs can attend, can you confirm whether the CIO + VP of Engineering would be the preferred attendees? If so, here are a couple of windows we can hold for an exec-friendly timeslot (all PDT):

- Tue Aug 31: 10:00–11:00 or 15:30–16:30
- Thu Sep 2: 09:30–10:30 or 14:00–15:00

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we'll bend. Attendees on our side would be: you (if attending), Jordan (sales lead), Ben (technical sales), and Olga (solutions engineer) as the primary demo lead.

I've attached a one-page agenda and a draft SOW so you can share with procurement if helpful (GLZ-demo-agenda-v1.pdf; GLZ-SOW-draft.docx).

Proposed agenda (short):
- 5 min intro & success criteria
- 30 min targeted demo (latency/cost live examples + architecture Qs)
- 5 min next steps & decision path

Thanks — happy to coordinate a calendar invite once you confirm a slot and attendee list.

Best,
Jordan Blake
